title: Helping Hands
angle: The one about coordination and dignity.
question: How do you make support delivery easier without making the process feel cold?
summary: Built a web app focused on making support delivery to people in need more seamless and accessible by automating key coordination flows.
lesson: This is where I started thinking less about screens and more about the human handoff behind them.

title: Little Go Agent
angle: The one where strategy became code.
question: What does good decision-making look like when the board is small but the branching factor is not?
summary: Developed an AI agent for 5x5 Go using minimax with alpha-beta pruning and reinforcement-learning approaches; achieved a 100% win rate against random/aggressive/greedy/minimax baselines and an overall 95.9% win rate.
lesson: A small board turned into a clean lesson in search, tradeoffs, and knowing when a model has enough information to act.

title: Support Systems for Driverless Cars
angle: The one that pulled research into the road.
question: What does a support system need to notice before the human does?
summary: As part of my final-year B.Tech project, developed four AV support modules: pothole detection, traffic light signal/counter detection, potential vehicle-to-animal accident detection, and vehicular accident detection.
lesson: It taught me to think in failure states: what needs to be noticed, when, and how clearly the system should respond.

title: Instagram Hashtag Generation via Scene Understanding
question: Can a model read a scene well enough to turn it into shareable language?
summary: Built a deep-learning engine that analyzes image scenes and generates Instagram-ready hashtags; won the Makerswave hackathon organized by Innovation Garage at NIT Warangal.
lesson: Fast prototypes are useful when they make the idea tangible enough for people to react to.

title: Computer Vision-based Accident Detection in Traffic Surveillance
summary: Conducted extensive research and implementation to design an efficient accident-detection algorithm for traffic surveillance camera feeds.

title: ASL Recognizer using Arduino and Machine Learning
summary: Developed a system using Computer Vision, ML, and Arduino to recognize ASL and translate gestures into spoken dialects; built a hardware setup with webcam, ultrasonic sensors, and servo motors to track hand movement, and won 1st place at INK Makeathon 2018 (350+ participants).

title: Flood Prediction Website
summary: Built and deployed a live weather + ML flood prediction platform on Microsoft Azure using Flask, Geocoding API, and Weather API; secured 3rd rank at NIT Warangal in Microsoft Code.Fun.Do++ Hackathon.

title: Space Swype
summary: Built a 3D version of a classic 2D shooter in Unity with C#, with Microsoft Azure SQL backend integration for high scores and leaderboards as part of Microsoft Code.Fun.Do Hackathon.

title: Portfolio Narrative Redesign
summary: Rebuilt my portfolio as a story-first experience with modular content sections, theme persistence, and responsive narrative layouts tailored to real project context.

title: Frontend Migration Playbook
summary: Created migration-oriented UI patterns and implementation guides focused on reducing manual effort and helping teams ship consistent interfaces through staged rollouts.
